newsitem.title: USA: Dade Cty, Fla., plans two December bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Dade Cty, Fla., plans two December bond issues.

text.p: Florida's Dade County gave preliminary approval Monday for two revenue bond issues, both tentatively set for December.
The county plans to issue $128 million of solid waste system revenue bonds the first week in December, with A.G. Edwards & Son Inc as senior managing underwriter.
In the third week of December, the county plans to issue $400 million to $450 million of water and sewer district revenue bonds, with PaineWebber Inc as senior managing underwriter.
Both deals were approved Monday by the Dade County Commission's Finance and Trust Funds Committee, which forwarded them to the full commission for final approval.
